Jane: Hey team — FYI customer GridScale (acct GS-223) flagged an unexpected negative line on INV-2026-3987: a -$12.48 "reserved commit proration" adjustment + a separate burst charge that looks like double-billing. Can someone check why a proration credit and a burst both applied for the same time window? :confused:
Omar: taking a look. Quick Q: did customer change their reserved commit mid-billing-period?
Jane: yep they reduced from 80 -> 60 GPUs on 2026-03-12 04:00 UTC. Finance expected a pro-rate credit but not overlapping burst charging.
Omar: I can see meter rows for that acct around that timestamp. There's an overlap where "reserved_commit_usage" and "burst_usage" both have entries for the same hour. Probably the commit ramp-down didn't silence burst meter.
Ryan: that matches a recent routing change — last Friday we changed the fallback policy so requests can hit the burst pool for up to 10m during drain windows. Might've left a tag unset so billing saw both as billable. Working on a patch.
billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-3987 generated 1964127800. Line items: reserved_commit_proration: -12.48, burst_overage: 12.48, net: 0.00. PDF: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-3987.pdf
Sophia: customer called — they want the proration credit applied but not the burst if net is zero. They asked for a short note in the invoice explaining the adjustment. Can finance confirm final amount so CS can respond? :eyes:
Omar: propose we reclassify those burst rows to "internal-fallback" (non-billable) for that hour and re-run invoice. I can produce recon CSV. Sample of meter rows:
```
acct,period_start,period_end,meter,units,price
GS-223,2026-03-12T04:00:00Z,2026-03-12T05:00:00Z,reserved_commit_usage,60,0.00
GS-223,2026-03-12T04:00:00Z,2026-03-12T05:00:00Z,burst_usage,5,2.496
```
Jane: ok Omar, do that recon and drop the burst charge for that overlapping hour. Also we need sign-off from Maya for >$10 adjustments. Maya can you approve a one-off reissue / credit for this invoice?
Maya: approved. Reissue invoice with explanation. Also please create a ticket so ops doesn't repeat.
Ryan: created internal issue BILL-4521 and put the routing-tag fix in a short PR. I'll link changes to the ticket.
Omar: recon CSV attached to the ticket and I queued a reissued invoice. Should show corrected INV-2026-3987R in ~30m.
Sophia: great — I'll tell GridScale we'll reissue and add the note. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jane: thanks. Follow-up: can eng add a simple unit test to prevent dual-metering on commit transitions? Ryan?
Ryan: yup adding test in next patch.
billing-bot: reissued invoice INV-2026-3987R generated 1964127985. PDF: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-3987R.pdf
